intro.text: The Encryption Certificate is used to encrypt data sent to your application — such as event notifications — ensuring only your application can read it.
When an LFI or the platform sends an encrypted payload, it encrypts it using the public key from this certificate. Your application uses the corresponding private key to decrypt it.

blocks.text: Follow the Keys & Certificates guide to generate your private key and CSR, then upload the CSR to the Trust Framework to receive your certificate.
When selecting the certificate type during generation, choose Encryption.
